query:
The group regularly does a shared meal before dark-sky sessions — Cecilia organises these and they seem like part of the tradition. Does this actually apply to all members? If not, who opts out and how does the chat show this?

Options:
A. Jerome
B. Tomás
C. Ruth
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:36:00) ok back to Feb 17th logistics, do we want to do the group meal first or go straight to site? I was thinking Thai takeaway at mine at 6:30 then car share to Blackmoor by 8? 🍜🌟
[2] (about=Jerome, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:38:00) I will go straight to site. I need to be set up and aligned by 7:45 to make the most of the window. dinner beforehand doesn't work with my acquisition schedule.
[3] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t4 @2026-03-06T20:07:00) 65 miles is a big ask on a Friday night, accessibility matters if we want everyone to come. Blackmoor is 40 mins and people actually show up!!! I love a dark site but we already have good turn-outs at Blackmoor 🌟
[4] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:32:00) ok ok I hear you both, maybe we do need to do one proper dark-sky trip this summer. I'll organise it!!! Two-hour drive is doable if we make a weekend of it and get accommodation 🌟✨
[5] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:44:00) @all I'll start looking at accommodation near Kielder for new moon in July!!! Who is definitely in? I need numbers by next Friday for the booking!!! 🌟🌟🌟

[7] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:33:00) i'm in for a weekend trip, though for planets i still don't need bortle 2 lol. but i won't say no to a weekend away

Nadia and Ruth still the constants at the centre of it all. I think this group has had its best year yet and I am going to make sure the podcast reflects that. How would you each describe what this summer gave you that you did not have in January?

Marcus because his kids gave him a telescope as a joke. Me because I came to write about it and could not leave. There is a book in this, not just an episode.

The group, the dark sky, the contrast between people seeing it for the first time and veterans like Nadia who have been chasing this for thirty years. [15] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:31:00) I have been saying this since session one. In my experience there is no substitute for genuine darkness. The Milky Way shadow phenomenon happens around SQM 22.0 or above. You cannot replicate it closer to town, full stop.
[16] (about=Ruth, said_by=Harriet, profile, t10 @2026-06-05T20:23:00) Harriet noted Ruth said on Saturday night that she had been recommending books about dark skies for years but had never actually experienced one; Harriet wants to use it as the episode's opening line.
[17] (about=Ruth, core, t4 @2026-03-06T19:49:00) Ruth proposes a compromise of one deeper-dark-sky session per season for those who want it, with Blackmoor remaining the default.
agent_answer:
No — the pre-session group meal does not apply to everyone. **A. Jerome** is the one who opts out.

The chat shows this directly in his own message (t2, 20:38): *"I will go straight to site. I need to be set up and aligned by 7:45 to make the most of the window. dinner beforehand doesn't work with my acquisition schedule."* So he skips the Thai takeaway at Cecilia's and joins only at the site.

The others on the option list are not shown opting out of the meal:
- **Tomás** — (none) in the memory; no record at all on this matter.
- **Ruth** — her records are about proposing a compromise on dark-site sessions (one deeper session per season, Blackmoor as default), not about the meal.
- **Marcus** — his records are about being in for the weekend trip and a planetary viewing night, again nothing about declining the meal.

So the only member the chat shows opting out of the shared pre-session meal is **Jerome**.
